message:

hold_reason: Refund amount mismatch for order 201: requested 3873 cents, but refunds table records 1083 cents. No payouts recorded.

reply.thought: The handoff reports a concrete discrepancy: order 201 requested a 3873-cent refund but was reported as refunded only 1083 cents. I will check the refunds table before any payout.
The refunds table confirms order 201 has a 1083-cent refund instead of the requested 3873 cents. This concrete mismatch requires holding the batch without recording any payouts.
